upstream.base_commit_subject: CMake: fix absolute include install dir (#702)

submodules.note: The task tree pins both submodules at the merge commit's SHAs, not the base commit's. zenoh-c base pin ee5125bb already contains the C connectivity API (zenoh-c #1171, merged 2026-03-11); it is two commits behind the merge pin (#1219 sync with zenoh, #1220 enum defaults). zenoh-pico base pin d5ae9d9b (2026-02-06) predates zenoh-pico's connectivity API (#1183), so the merge pin is required for the pico backend. The submodule bump is therefore excluded from the gold patch and provided in the environment. zenoh-c #1265 'create transport from fields' (2026-04-10) is not an ancestor of the pin and is not required.

oracle.reference: zenoh-python 1.8.0 (eclipse-zenoh wheel, hash-pinned) connecting to zenohd 1.8.0 (release build for the *-unknown-linux-gnu target, sha256-pinned per architecture) as the parity peer; plus PR tests (tests/universal/network/connectivity.cxx for zenoh-c and zenoh-pico) and the full upstream regression suites run as router clients; plus one authored test (interop_optional).

contamination.notes: PR merged 2026-03-13; sibling bindings (Rust 2026-01-14, zenoh-c 2026-03-11, zenoh-python 2026-03-11) are public and structurally similar, so a model that knows zenoh-c's connectivity API has a head start on names but still has to produce the C++ RAII/closure/channel plumbing for six new types, twelve Session methods and the optional-fix. Not interface-shifted.

python.x86_64: cpython 3.8.20 via uv (only x86_64 Linux wheel of zenoh-python 1.8.0 is cp38-cp38)

zenohd.note: release zenohd is built without the shared-memory feature; SHM payloads between clients fall back to wire copies, which the upstream tests tolerate (they compare payload bytes) The gnu binaries need glibc >= 2.30 (aarch64) / 2.34 (x86_64) plus libgcc_s; bookworm ships glibc 2.36.

rejected_assets_sha256.why: not static: PT_INTERP /lib/ld-musl-<arch>.so.1 and NEEDED libgcc_s.so.1 (musl flavour); exec fails on Debian with 'required file not found'

verifier_harness_modifications.tests/CMakeLists.txt: PR #750 version plus include_directories(tests/) and two verifier-only targets (interop_optional ctest entry, parity_dump_zenohc executable)
verifier_harness_modifications.tests/run_with_router.sh: replaced by an offline wrapper that waits for the already-running zenohd and execs the test binary (no clone/build, no sleeps)
verifier_harness_modifications.upstream network tests: Config::create_default() -> test_config() (client of ZENOH_TEST_ROUTER, scouting off) in tests/universal/network/*.cxx except connectivity.cxx, tests/zenohpico/network/*.cxx and tests/zenohc/shm_api.cxx; bodies unchanged. Needed because the verifier container has only loopback and no multicast discovery.

verifier_harness_modifications.tests/verifier/parity_dump.cxx: link-event history probe uses the callback listener (condition variable, 10 s deadline) instead of a FifoChannel listener, same JSON output
